Name: Door Randomizer
Author: AqueleCass
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
Stardew Valley Door Randomizer randomizes doors, entrances, exits, and location transitions throughout Stardew Valley based on your world seed.
Each seed generates a different set of connections, changing how you navigate the world. Connections remain consistent, so returning through an entrance takes you back to the location you came from.
The mod includes configurable options, safe location support, Generic Mod Config Menu integration, and compatibility with other mods.
Available in English, Brazilian Portuguese, and Spanish.
[b]Note:[/b] Doors belonging to farm buildings, such as the farmhouse and chicken coops, are not randomized.
[heading]Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI if you haven't already.[/*]
[*]Download and install Stardew Valley Door Randomizer.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]For in-game configuration, install Generic Mod Config Menu if you want to use its interface.
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Seed-Based Randomization:[/b] Different world seeds generate different randomized connections.[/*]
[*][b]Consistent Connections:[/b] Entering and leaving locations maintains consistent connections, allowing you to return to where you came from.[/*]
[*][b]Safe Locations:[/b] Support for safe locations to help control the randomization.[/*]
[*][b]Configurable Options:[/b] Enable or disable available randomization options to customize your experience.[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu Support:[/b] Configure supported settings through the in-game menu.[/*]
[*][b]Mod Compatibility:[/b] Includes support for working alongside other mods.[/*]
[*][b]Multilingual Support:[/b] Available in English, Brazilian Portuguese, and Spanish.[/*]
[/list][b]Excluded:[/b] Doors of farm buildings, including the farmhouse and chicken coops, are not randomized.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] for in-game configuration.[/*]
[/list]Make sure SMAPI is installed and working correctly before launching the game.
[heading]Shout Outs[/heading]
Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community for creating tools, sharing documentation, and making mod development possible.
Special thanks to the creators of SMAPI and Generic Mod Config Menu for their contributions to the Stardew Valley modding ecosystem.
